summary: 37-year-old solo hiker stranded in thigh-to-hip-deep snow on the north side of Frigid Air Pass on the Four Pass Loop; texted 911 'Please help me' Thursday evening after telling family her phone battery was at 10%, then lost contact. CareFlight 3 located her about 11 p.m. but could not land; a five-person Crested Butte Search and Rescue ground team hiked overnight from the West Maroon trailhead and reached her about 6 a.m. Friday Oct 30, unable to walk with cold-related injuries and signs of hypothermia; a Colorado Army National Guard UH-60 Black Hawk hoisted her out about 9:15 a.m. and she was flown to the UCHealth Burn and Frostbite Center in Aurora.
location: Frigid Air Pass, Four Pass Loop, Maroon Bells-Snowmass Wilderness
notes: Freshness sweep 2026-11-03: SnowBrains report citing a Crested Butte Search and Rescue post; incident began Thursday evening Oct 29, rescue completed Friday morning Oct 30.
